## [You customer service is not only…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6419ce861f08d0d0848ce7e1)
You customer service is not only horrible, it's also non-existent. It's a poor business choice to have zero way to contact the business. When selling big-ticket items, sometimes up to 10's of thousands of dollars, you should look at your competitors who do the same and wonder why they're more successful than you are. It's most certainly because they actually allow humans to talk to humans.

March 1, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Mar 22, 2023

Hi James, thank you so much for your feedback, we are incredibly sorry to hear about your shopping experience with us. You can find our Contact Form on our website, or you can always email us at support@luluandgeorgia.com. We are also available on Live Chat Monday-Friday 9am-5pm PST and we offer scheduled phone call backs, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
